technology_name: AN EDIBLE EVENT-RESPONSIVE PHOTODETECTOR FOR LIGHT INTENSITY DETECTION AND METHOD OF OPERATION THEREOF
institution: National Institute of Technology Calicut (NIT Calicut)
problem_solved: Standard optoelectronic light sensors utilize heavy, non-biodegradable, and bio-toxic semiconductor elements that cannot be ingested or safely integrated into short-lifecycle product packaging.
description: A completely digestible, zero-power optoelectronic sensor device fabricated entirely over edible base substrates containing integrated organic electrodes, a liquid transport channel, an internal host medium, and an active photo-responsive layer that modulates current profiles matching visible light changes.
applications: Smart ingestible medical diagnostics, active food spoilage packaging tags, agricultural freshness monitoring labels, and eco-friendly consumer goods authentication trackers.
